root_cause.text: Module unload proceeds without waiting for fabric scan completion, causing DMA memory to be freed in interrupt context when the UNLOADING flag prevents work queue allocation during ongoing device discovery.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a check for `(vha->scan.scan_flags & SF_SCANNING)` to the `qla2x00_wait_for_hba_ready()` function's wait condition. This prevents module unload from proceeding while a fabric scan is in progress. The CVE description explicitly states: "A module unload was issued which set the UNLOADING flag. As part of the discovery, after receiving an interrupt a work queue was scheduled... Since the UNLOADING flag is set, the work item was not allocated and the mapped memory had to be freed. The free occurred in interrupt context leading to system crash." The fix delays unload by adding the scan completion check to the wait loop, ensuring DMA cleanup happens in safe (non-interrupt) context rather than in the interrupt handler.
